heading: Short title
lead: This chapter may be cited as the “Commodity Exchange Act.”

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: This chapter superseded act Aug. 24, 1921, ch. 86, 42 Stat. 187, known as “The Future Trading Act,” which act was declared unconstitutional, at least in part, in Hill v. Wallace, Ill. 1922, 42 S.Ct. 453, 259 U.S. 44, 66 L.Ed. 822. Section 3 of that act was found unconstitutional as imposing a penalty in Trusler v. Crooks, Mo. 1926, 46 S.Ct. 165, 269 U.S. 475, 70 L.Ed. 365.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1936—Act June 15, 1936, substituted “Commodity Exchange Act” for “The Grain Futures Act”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1936 Amendment
notes.text: Act June 15, 1936, ch. 545, § 13, 49 Stat. 1501, provided that: “All provisions of this Act [see Tables for classification] authorizing the registration of futures commission merchants and floor brokers, the fixing of fees and charges therefor, the promulgation of rules, regulations and orders, and the holding of hearings precedent to the promulgation of rules, regulations, and orders shall be effective immediately. All other provisions of this Act shall take effect ninety days after the enactment of this Act [June 15, 1936].”

notes.heading: Short Title of 2015 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. notes.text: Pub. L. 110–234, title XIII, § 13001, May 22, 2008, 122 Stat. 1427, and Pub. notes.heading: Short Title of 1995 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 104–9, § 1, Apr. 21, 1995, 109 Stat. 154, provided that: “This Act [amending section 16 of this title] may be cited as the ‘CFTC Reauthorization Act of 1995’.”

notes.heading: Short Title of 1992 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. notes.text: Pub. notes.heading: Short Title of 1983 Amendment
